parts.text: State what is meant by the Doppler effect.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
A child sits on a rotating horizontal platform in a playground. The child moves with a constant speed along a circular path, as illustrated in Fig. 4.1.

{{figure:figure_4_1.png}}

An observer is standing a long distance away from the child. During one particular revolution, the child, moving at a speed of 7.5 m s$^{-1}$, starts blowing a whistle at point P and stops blowing it at point Q on the circular path.

The whistle emits sound of frequency 950 Hz. The speed of sound in air is 330 m s$^{-1}$.
parts.text:
Determine the maximum frequency of the sound heard by the distant observer.

(Hz)

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Describe the variation in the frequency of the sound heard by the distant observer.
